provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.en: Week start and weekend come from the region

statement.ar: أول أيام الأسبوع وأيام العطلة يُؤخذان من بيانات المنطقة (البلد)، لا من اللغة، ويمكن للمستخدم تغييرهما.
statement.en: The first day of the week and the weekend days are taken from the region's (country's) data, not from the language, and the person can change them.

rationale.ar: يبدأ الأسبوع السبت في مصر والأحد في السعودية والاثنين في المغرب وتونس، والعطلة الجمعة والسبت في بلدان والسبت والأحد في أخرى، واللغة واحدة.
rationale.en: The week starts on Saturday in Egypt, Sunday in Saudi Arabia and Monday in Morocco and Tunisia; the weekend is Friday–Saturday in some countries and Saturday–Sunday in others, with one language.

checks: The first column of the calendar grid equals the region's firstDay (dates cases tagged week record what ICU returns for 19 regions).
Changing language while keeping region does not change the first column.
Weekend styling is driven by region data, not by a hard-coded pair of days.
